evals.prompt: Our churn is 8% monthly. We're building a win-back email campaign.
evals.expected_output: Should redirect: 60-70% of annual churn happens in the first 90 days, so a win-back campaign works on the smaller half. Should push effort to onboarding and time-to-value. Should place 8% against benchmarks (2-4% SMB/prosumer, so 8% is high). Should demand cohort analysis rather than blended churn, and check whether later cohorts outperform earlier ones.
assertions: Requires cohort analysis over blended churn
States that later cohorts should outperform earlier ones

evals.prompt: What's our aha moment? Users understand the value of the product after the tour.
evals.expected_output: Should reject 'understands the value' as unmeasurable. An aha moment must be a countable event, found by comparing what retained users did in their first session against churned users. Should give examples: Slack 2,000 team messages, Dropbox first shared folder, Notion second page, Facebook 7 friends in 10 days. Should note completing a tour is not activation.
assertions: Recommends measuring time to value instead of completion rate
